name: GetDropDownSelectedItem
label: Get Selected Item from Drop-Down List
description: Reads and returns the selected item from a drop-down list in a window using the property you choose.

fields.name: IdentificationObjectPath
fields.label: UI Element
fields.description: The UI element which you would like to read the selected item from.

fields.name: MaxWaitTime
fields.label: Max Wait Time (seconds)
fields.description: Maximum time to wait to find the UI element (in seconds).

fields.name: SelectedItem
fields.label: Selected Item
fields.description: The selected item found in the drop-down list.
